blocks.title: Valence electrons
blocks.text: Atom ke sab se bahar wale shell (outermost shell) ke electrons ko valence electrons kehte hain.

Yahi electrons zyada tar chemical reactions mein hissa lete hain. Jin elements ke valence electrons ki configuration milti julti ho, un ki chemical properties (khoobiyan) bhi milti julti hoti hain; isi liye ek group ke elements ek jaisa behaviour (rawaiya) dikhate hain.
Figure 2.15 ek aisa periodic table dikhati hai jis mein har element ki valence shell configuration likhi hai. Kisi bhi group (column) mein dekhein: configuration ek jaisi hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table jis ke har khaane mein atomic number, symbol aur us unsur ki valence-shell configuration hai, H 1s1 se Og 7s2 5f14 6d10 7p6 tak, aur lanthanides Ce se Lu aur actinides Th se Lr neeche do qataaron mein. Rang s block (gulabi), d block (halka peela-hara), p block (hara) aur f block (halka jamni) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.15: Modern periodic table ke elements ki electronic distribution (kitab ki Figure 2.15 ke mutabiq original drawing).
blocks.long_description: Har group ka ek pattern hai: group 1 mein ns1, group 2 mein ns2, groups 13 se 18 mein ns2 np1 se ns2 np6, aur groups 3 se 12 mein ns ke saath (n-1)d, kuch istisna ke saath jaise Cr 4s1 3d5, Cu 4s1 3d10, Nb, Mo, Ru, Rh, Pd, Ag, Pt aur Au. f qataarein 4f aur 5f bharti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.15 mein paanch ghaltiyan hain: element 76 ko ‘Re’ likha hai (sahi Os); Tc ko 5s¹ 4d⁶ (sahi 5s² 4d⁵), Pt ko 6s² 4f¹⁴ 5d⁹ (sahi 6s¹ 4f¹⁴ 5d⁹), Au ko 6s² 4f¹⁴ 5d¹⁰ (sahi 6s¹ 4f¹⁴ 5d¹⁰) aur Yb ko 6s² 4f¹³ (sahi 6s² 4f¹⁴). Upar ki drawing mein yeh sahi hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kisi bhi column mein oopar se neeche dekhein: aakhri configuration ka pattern wahi rehta hai, sirf shell number badalta hai (maslan group 17: 2s²2p⁵, 3s²3p⁵, 4s²4p⁵). Isi liye ek group ki chemistry milti julti hai.

blocks.prompt: Chlorine (3s² 3p⁵) aur bromine (4s² 4p⁵) bohat milte julte tareeqe se react karte hain. Valence electrons se wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono ke saat valence electrons ns² np⁵ pattern mein hain, yani poore shell se ek kam. Reactions valence electrons se hoti hain, is liye dono ek electron lene ki tendency (rujhan) rakhte hain aur ek jaisa behave karte hain.

items: Valence electrons = sab se bahar wale shell ke electrons; reactions inhi se hoti hain.
Ek group ki valence configuration ek jaisi, is liye chemistry bhi milti julti.
